Name: Accessible Flower Dance Clearing
Author: Suntooth
Description:
[size=3]With this mod, you can enter the clearing from the Flower Dance year-round. But between dances it's left alone by the townsfolk, so it's in a bit of disrepair...[/size]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Access the Flower Dance clearing throughout the entire year, not just when the festival's on[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Forage for flowers[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Catch fish, including Gobies in the waterfall[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Cut down trees and weeds for a little extra resources[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=3]This mod probably isn't compatible with any other mod that adds an area accessed using the Flower Dance bridge. Also, foragables and fish added by other mods won't show up in the clearing. It should be largely compatible with recolours (for example, Starblue Valley is used in the listed screenshots).[/size]
[size=3]If you're asking "does this mod clash with [other mod]", my answer will usually be "I don't know". Feel free to let me know if a mod is incompatible, but do not expect fixes from me unless it's a mod that I use myself.[/size]

[size=4][b]Translations[/b][/size]
[size=3]Please contact me before creating a translation - I will gladly add it to the mod! But don't use generative AI/LLMs to create any part of your translation.[/size]
[size=3]Current languages supported:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]English[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Welsh (via my own currently unpublished language mod)[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Future plans[/b][/size]
[size=3]In the future, I'd love to learn pixel art so that I can add some custom fish or foragables to the area. I don't know if it'll ever happen, though. It's possible I may add extra areas too, especially to the left of the clearing, which is currently blocked off by a barrier like during the festival. (Plus there's a couple of secrets I'd like to add...)[/size]

[size=4][b]Disclaimer[/b][/size]
[size=3]This is my first ever map mod, so it may be a little janky in places. Please be patient with me if any bugs pop up![/size]

Manifest.Name: Accessible Flower Dance Clearing
Manifest.Description: Adds the Flower Dance clearing as an accessible area year-round.
